releaseNotes:
Release v0.13.0

New Features:
- Image Difference node + image preview in the IDE (#188)
- Signed update manifests (Ed25519) with in-app verification (PS-179)

Bug Fixes:
- Custom Python nodes now register reliably via a persistent custom_nodes_ws reconnect (#187)

Improvements:
- Command DataSource execution is now gated against the filesystem access policy (PS-181)
